SELECT /* LGVPAY00011.retrievePaySlipOpenDateMngList */ a.payroll_calculation_exec_id , to_char(to_date(b.payroll_calc_period_value,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') pay_months , c.common_code_name as pay_type_name , ( SELECT sum(s.bank_transfer_amount) FROM tb_pay_result_s s WHERE s.payroll_calculation_exec_id = a.payroll_calculation_exec_id) as net_take_amount , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_pay_result_s s WHERE s.payroll_calculation_exec_id = a.payroll_calculation_exec_id) as total_count , a.soe_open_date , to_char( a.soe_open_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') as pay_slip_open_date , to_char( a.soe_open_date,'hh24') as hour , to_char( a.soe_open_date,'mi') as minutes FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n a , tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n b , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c c WHERE a.basis_date BETWEEN to_Date(b.start_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(b.end_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd') AND b.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND a.confirm_flag = 'Y' AND c.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND c.common_code = a.payroll_type_code AND c.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND b.payroll_calc_period_value = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue},'mm/yyyy'),'yyyymm') AND a.payroll_type_code = #{payrollTypeCode}
AND a.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00011.updatePaySlipOpenDateMng */ tb_pay_calc_exec_n SET soe_open_date = to_date(#{soeOpenDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI') WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId}
